acquisition_channels.details: They used Lob to mail physical postcards with QR codes linking each business to its preview site.
A part-time salesperson called the businesses, prioritizing people who had scanned their postcard.

ideas.delivery: OpenClaw found businesses and contact details, then generated preview sites from public information. Lob mailed QR-code postcards. A salesperson called prospects, and a person closed the marketing package; the site was offered free with a marketing contract.

prices: A handful of cents in tokens per website

ideas.other_uk_rules: For a UK version, screen calls against CTPS and calls to sole traders against TPS. Cold email is allowed only to corporate subscribers with an opt-out. Use a lawful basis and appropriate notices for prospect data under UK GDPR.

idea.name: Facebook Marketplace to eBay arbitrage
idea.one_liner: Use an agent to find underpriced local items on Facebook Marketplace, buy them and resell them on eBay for a margin.
idea.customer: Buyers on resale marketplaces; the initial sellers are people listing local goods on Facebook Marketplace.
idea.offer: Resell items such as shoes or couches after comparing local listings with eBay prices.
idea.revenue_model: Profit from the difference between the purchase price and resale proceeds after fees.
